caption: This drawing features a detailed graphite illustration of a metallic mug or tankard with a handle, positioned centrally within a large rectangular frame that is itself drawn on a cream-colored or slightly yellowed paper. The mug is cylindrical with a slightly flared base and mouth, adorned with horizontal banding near the top and bottom. To the lower right of the main composition, there is a smaller rectangular inset containing a side profile line drawing of the same mug, annotated with written dimensions: 5 inches in height and 4 inches in width. The upper left corner of the paper has a small piece of yellowed tape affixed, and at the bottom left, the name "V. Carano" is written in small, neat letters. The entire composition is monochromatic, rendered in shades of grey from the pencil work.
title: Silver Mug
